screens.title: Home, Today: one Get started checklist while an item is to do, Needs you, My items with their count in the heading, My agents with the spend of today in the heading, no stat tiles
Home, Today, light theme
Design: the diagram or picture fits the zoom frame at the first paint; a sideways gesture or a drag pans it, a pinch zooms it, Fit brings it back
Specs
Work
Factory / Runs: no tiles, one bar with search, the filter All, Needs you and Mine, and Board and History; five lanes that fit with a count each; a card with its one action and a menu with Stop
Factory / Agents map: a node shows the ticket key and title, the step name or the file name; the ref is the tooltip and Copy ref is in the node menu; a run node opens the run page
Code: tabs with icons; the Terminal button of the top bar opens the terminal drawer
Knowledge: tabs with icons; the manual opens from the account menu, F1 or the palette, not from a tab
Top bar: sidebar toggle, Back and Forward, Sync with ahead and behind, Activity, search, Files and Terminal buttons, Ask split button, notifications, account menu
Projects: Clone and Open
Menu bar panel: spend, runs with Stop, Needs you, agents switch, sync, project, Open Shipyard
Knowledge / Slides: HTML deck in a sandboxed frame, Present, Export PDF; Markdown deck read only with Convert
Assistant: message box, then one bar with attach, the model and effort menu, the permission, the context ring and Send
Settings / Connections: each MCP server has an allow list picker (All tools, Read only, Custom with one checkbox for each tool)
Onboarding tour: six steps with a title, one sentence and a picture; opens once after the first project; Close, Back, Next, Done and Open the manual
Settings / Me, Permissions: each OS permission with its state and one action; the Get started checklist; the section list
Settings / Project: a section list that stays in view, with an icon per section, above panels with an icon in each heading
Settings / Me: the Theme select (Light, Dark, OLED, System, System with OLED, imported themes), Theme files with Import and Export, a row for each imported theme with Remove, and the preview dialog
Factory / Workflows: the list shows each name with its step names; Duplicate, Rename and Delete are in the More actions menu; the id shows in the editor header

Settings / Me: the Language select (English, French, German, Spanish, imported languages), Language files with Import language and Export English, the Mark untranslated text switch when a language file is current, a row for each imported language with Remove, and the import dialog
New project: the five steps of the creator, the preview of the files and the start choice
Work / Team: the members and the rights of each role and member, by area
Factory / Runs: a run page with a summary, the one action of the state, what needs you, and the tabs Activity, Changes and Workflow
Factory / Runs, History: each ended run and each older run of a ticket, newest end first, with search; a row opens the run
Factory / Usage: the success rate, the Budgets panel with Edit, and the runs with their key and title
Activity panel: the Activity button with the needs-you count; Needs you with a link to Home / Today, Runs with Stop, Sessions with Stop
Account menu: Settings / Me, Theme (Light, Dark, System), Manual, Shortcuts, What's new, Replay the tour
No project: one page for every space with Open a folder, Clone a repository and New project
First run: the role step with Continue, then the open-a-project step
